verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing docs explicitly describe automating recurring payments, custom pricing plans, trial periods, renewals, and a customer portal for subscription/billing management, plus migration support for existing subscriptions — directly matching the story's core ask.  Missing for 10: explicit documentation of proration mechanics on plan upgrades/downgrades, and independent hands-on developer corroboration specifically confirming trial/upgrade/proration behavior (only general positive community sentiment about ease of setup exists).
